# Spring-NWVMC (`0.1.0` — Official Maven Central)

> Official Documentation Portal & Universal AI-Agent Adoption Kit for **Spring-NWVMC `0.1.0`** (`io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` on Maven Central).
> Live Interactive Portal (20 languages): https://natswarchuan.github.io/Spring-NWVMC-document/
> Framework Source Repository: https://github.com/NatswarChuan/Spring-NWVMC

## Quick Facts

- **Maven Central Coordinate:** `io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` (Java 21 LTS + Spring Boot 3.2.5 / 3.3.5 / 3.4.0; `<parameters>true</parameters>` required)
- **Optional JitPack Mirror:** `com.github.NatswarChuan:Spring-NWVMC:v0.1.0`
- **2-Directory Contract:** `entity/` (JPA `@Entity` extending `BaseAuditEntity`, NEVER `@Data`, NEVER `@SoftDelete`) + `controller/` (`@AutoRestController` interface extending `AutoApiController<E>` or narrow composable interfaces `AutoReadApi<E>`..`AutoAiApi<E>`).
- **6 Exact Annotation Packages (60 annotations, 133 attributes):** `io.github.natswarchuan.core.annotation.*` (54), `io.github.natswarchuan.module.cache.http.annotation.HttpCacheable`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.datasource.annotation.{TargetDataSource, TargetDatabasePlatform}`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.event.annotation.PublishCloudEvent`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.lock.annotation.DistributedLock`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.webhook.annotation.EntityWebhook`.
- **Verified Runtime Rules:** `@StateMachine` colon syntax `"FROM:TO1,TO2"` + `POST /{id}/transition?targetState=...`; dot-syntax query filters (`.gte`, `.like`); `ObjectProvider<T>` for framework `@AutoComponent` helpers; non-final `@Lazy @Service` + lazy caller injection (`ObjectProvider<MyService>`/`@Lazy`) for AOP; NEVER `@Transactional` on `public final class` Helpers; dev JWT endpoint `POST /api/v1/auth/token?username=admin&role=ROLE_ADMIN`; `JwtTokenService.generateToken(username, userId, roles)` (`username` FIRST); `studio.enabled=false` & `JWT_SECRET >= 32` bytes in production.
